name: The HeavenlyDemonKing God-Sechs -Type Heaven-
name_jp: 天魔王ゴッド・ゼクス -天ノ型-
text:
Count +1

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn/Attacks)
Send three cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Trash.
{{Six Heaven Rush|5}}
If you have five or more colors of symbols, this effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Magic effects.
{{Six Heaven Rush|6}}
If you have six colors of symbols, all your Spirits can't be blocked.

name: The HeavenlyDemonKing God-Sechs -Type Final-
name_jp: 天魔王ゴッド・ゼクス -焉ノ型-
text:
Count +1

[LV1] (When Reborn)
Return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.
{{Six Heaven Rush|5}}
If you have five or more symbol colors, destroy five opposing non-"Primal" family Grandwalker Nexuses.

[LV1] Return to Prime
When it would leave the Field due to an opposing effect, you can flip and deploy it.

name: The FungalBeast SheeSheep -Battle Form-
name_jp: 菌獣シーシープ -戦闘態-
text:
Count +1

[LV1][LV2] (When Reborn/Attacks)
You can put a core from the Void to any of your "Fungal Tree" family Spirit/Nexus. Then, once per turn, if you have six counters or more, return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, by destroying one of your "Fungal Bed", exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate, or return an opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.
note: Back face of BS73-026 (v579). Count +1 is done by the flip. The Flash 'or' is two Invoke effects sharing one once-per-turn key.

name: The FungalBeast GoriGorilla -Battle Form-
name_jp: 菌獣ゴリゴリラ -戦闘態-
text:
Count +1

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can send out one of your "Fungal Bed" Tokens. When you've done so, you can put one core from the Void each to two "Fungal Bed" you control. Then, you can heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. 

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
While your "Devotee"/"Fungal Tree" family Spirit is attacking/blocking, the opponent can't activate Burst effects.
note: Back face of BS73-028 (v579). Count +1 is done by the flip. Two cores go to Fungal Beds without enforcing two different Beds.

name: The GreatMushroomMan Oninarada
text:
Count +1

[LV1][LV2]
(Can't Stack) Once per turn, when your counter increases, if you control four or less "Fungal Bed", you can send out one of your "Fungal Bed" Tokens.

[LV1][LV2] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
The opponent discards cards from their Hand until their Hand is four. 

[LV2]
While you control three or more "Fungal Bed", this Spirit gains +10000 BP, and its symbol is fixed as two Green symbols.
note: Back face of BS73-067 (v579). Count +1 by the flip. The REBORN core to self models 'put a core to this Reborn Spirit'.

name: The FungalBeastKing Uaxa-Ctuun -Battle Form-
name_jp: 菌獣王ワシャ・クトゥーン -戦闘態-
text:
Count +1

{{Unleash|2}} [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
By sending two cores from any of your Green Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit, during this turn, opposing "can't summon" effects don't activate. Then, (Once per Turn: Same Name) you can reveal four cards from your decktop. By destroying any number of "Fungal Bed" you control, for each target destroyed, summon one "Fungal Tree" family card among them, without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Neither player can use cards with a cost equal or inferior to your number of counters during Flash Timing.
note: Back face of BS73-TX02 (v580). Count +1 by the flip. Unleash = the two-core payment from a green Grandwalker Nexus. The opposing can't-summon clause has no engine effect to suppress (none exists). FLASH_COST_LOCK covers Magic cards only. Only Spirit cards are summoned from the reveal.

name: The PearlHolyFaeKnight Pearel
name_jp: 真珠の妖聖騎士パーレル
text:
Count +1

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. Immediately activate one of the Flash effects of a "Prismwing" family Magic card among them, without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
After your Magic effects resolves, you can return an opposing LV1/LV3 Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.
note: Rebirth back face (display only): the flip rule is not in the engine yet.

name: The CitrineMajewelGirl Citri
name_jp: 黄水晶の魔宝少女シトリィー
text:
Count +1

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a Yellow Rebirth card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When opposing Spirits are brought to 0 BP, you can send four cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.
note: Rebirth back face (display only): the flip rule is not in the engine yet.

name: The GarnetMajewelSwordsman Garneta
name_jp: 柘榴石の魔宝剣士ガーネッタ
text:
Count +1

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit/Ultimate -10000 BP, and destroy it when it is brought to 0 BP. If you have five counters or more, the target of this "BP- Effect" gets +2. 

[LV2][LV3] (Your Turn)
When summoning your "Prismwing" family Spirit cards without paying the cost, the effects of every opposing Spirit/Nexus can't activate.
note: Assumed: 'the target of this BP- Effect gets +2' means two more targets (3 at 5+ counters). 'Without paying the cost' is read as any summon through an effect (subjViaEffect).

name: The JewelEmpress Bijour-Joyaux
name_jp: 宝石の女皇帝ビジュール・ジュワイオー
text:
Count +1

{{Unleash|1}} [LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
By sending one core from any of your Yellow Grandwalker Nexuses to this Spirit, during this turn, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, and all your Spirits can't be blocked. 

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can +2 cores to one of your Yellow-only Grandwalker Nexuses. When you've done so, (Once per Game: Same Name) if you have five counters or more, until the End Step of your next turn, even if your deck is zero, or your Life becomes zero, you won't lose the game.
note: Rebirth back face. Assumed: 'all your Spirits can't be blocked' affects the Spirits on the field when it resolves; the 5-counter check is made after the +2 cores.
